name: hai-browser-next
description: Dev-only Next.js plugin (Turbopack and webpack) that tags JSX elements with their source file and line so H/Ai can jump from the page to the code.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --outfile=dist/index.cjs && esbuild src/loader.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node20 --outfile=dist/loader.cjs --external:@babel/parser --external:magic-string && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
